name: radio-group
useFor: Use for one choice among two to five options that all need to be seen (zoning, a search radius). Pass each label as the item's children. For more options use Select; for a view switch use Toggle Group.
constraints: A radio group with one option (use Checkbox)
Options chosen by default when there is no safe default
source: Figma "UI · Controls" (442:145): Industrial, selected and not
title: Radio group
description: The diamond radio: a 16px outline diamond, Stone when not chosen and Forest when chosen with a solid 7px Forest diamond in its center. Its label is 13px Forest 12px after it; options stack 12px apart.
